caveat: A single peak at the expected temperature does not guarantee that it is the intended amplicon (MIQE 2.0).
message: This file has no melt curves. For SYBR Green or another DNA-binding dye, export the melt curves with the amplification (CFX: Melt Curve RFU Results; QuantStudio: Melt Curve Raw Data; or an RDML file with its melt data) and open them together.
